主要内容: The U.S. Treasury Department announced the release of the 2016 U.S. Model Income Tax Treaty on February 17, 2016. This treaty serves as the baseline text used in negotiating tax treaties. The 2016 Model includes provisions aimed at eliminating double taxation without creating opportunities for non-taxation or reduced taxation through tax evasion or avoidance. It also addresses corporate inversions by denying reduced withholding taxes on U.S. source payments made by companies that engage in inversions. The Treasury Department emphasized the importance of resolving disputes between tax authorities through mandatory binding arbitration, aligning with existing U.S. tax treaties. The 2016 Model reflects feedback from comments received on the proposed model treaty provisions released in May 2015. The U.S. Treasury Department has announced the release of the 2016 U.S. Model Income Tax Treaty, which includes a detailed technical explanation. This explanation is intended to address certain situations related to the 'active trade or business' test under Article 22 (Limitation on Benefits). The Treasury plans to release this technical explanation this spring. The preamble to the 2016 Model invites public comments on these situations, and the deadline for submitting feedback is April 18, 2016. The public can access the 2016 Model and its accompanying preamble for further details.
